etsy.title: Handwritten Pace Notes Print, Rally Co-Driver Wall Art, Motorsport Gift for Him, Garage Race Decor
etsy.description:
A handwritten pace notes print that looks like a co-driver's notebook page: L4 over crest, don't cut, caution, flat out, with pen-drawn arrows.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang it in a garage, man cave, home office, or on a rally fan's wall.

An original design with no team, series, or manufacturer marks.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: A search for pace-notes posters found no ready-made print. Pace notes appear only on a metal sign, a licence-plate sign, mugs, and t-shirts.
Co-driver gifts that do exist are stickers, a metal sign, and apparel, so a notebook-style pace-notes print fills a gap.
Some rally prints in the same results are digital-download sets; stating 'physical poster print' sets this listing apart.
On Amazon, 'Rally Pace Notes Co Driver' appears only on sweatshirts, tumblers, and tees; no posters.
Rally humour on Amazon is mostly slogan shirts and totes, worded as 'funny rally driver gift'.

research.notes: Keyword phrases from research/keywords/rally.json (search-results, 2026-11-01). 'pace notes' and 'pacenotes' are seen phrases (mugs and shirts), not indexed Etsy market pages. I chose them anyway because no pace-notes poster competes, and 'handwritten' separates this design from the stencil pace-note posters. 'handwritten pace notes print' itself has no direct search evidence. No priceRange: no comparable physical prices were seen.
